jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst
jobs.content: <p>Join our lending team to analyse funnels, conversion and retention across our credit products. You will own metrics, build dashboards and run deep dives with product and business teams.<br><br>Requirements<br>• 2-5 years of experience in analytics<br>• Strong SQL and Python (Pandas)<br>• Power BI or Tableau dashboards<br>• A/B testing and statistics<br>• Stakeholder management and data storytelling<br><br>Nice to have<br>• BigQuery or Snowflake<br>• dbt<br></p>

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Lending
jobs.content:
Work with the payments and lending business to build KPI frameworks and MIS reporting. You will own metrics, build dashboards and run deep dives with product and business teams.

Requirements
• 3-6 years of experience in analytics
• Strong SQL and Python (Pandas)
• Power BI or Tableau dashboards
• A/B testing and statistics
• Stakeholder management and data storytelling

Nice to have
• BigQuery or Snowflake
• dbt
